name: Oxytocin
description: A nonapeptide hormone of the posterior pituitary, approved as Pitocin for the initiation or augmentation of uterine contractions. Intranasal use for social or affective effect is off-label and unapproved.

systems.note: Supplies a posterior pituitary hormone; placed on the pituitary by intended effect.
Central effects sought off-label are not a labelled indication and are uncharacterised at those routes.
Antidiuretic activity causes water intoxication and hyponatraemia; labelled.

monitors.why: Antidiuretic cross-reactivity causes labelled water intoxication and hyponatraemia.
